newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore April container throughput falls 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore April container throughput falls 4.0 pct.

text.p: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) said on Wednesday April container throughput fell four percent to 1.14 million TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units) compared with March but tonnage rose.
MPA said in its latest monthly report that container throughput registered for March was 1.187 million TEU.
Total cargo tonnage moving through Singapore in April rose to 28.3 million tonnes from March's 28 million tonnes, it said.
In April, 10,332 vessels called at the port, compared with 10,603 in November.
Bunker fuel sales for 380-centistoke fuel oil was 819,900 tonnes in April, down from 872,700 tonnes in March.
The 180-centistoke fuel oil sales were 384,500 tonnes, also down from March's 380,600 tonnes.
